extension.summary: Mafab.hu movie database: trailers, movie lists, search
extension.description: A Mafab.hu magyar filmadatbázis böngészése Kodiból: előzetesek és videók, legjobb filmek és sorozatok, új adatlapok, keresés. Nem hivatalos kiegészítő.
Browse the Hungarian Mafab.hu movie database from Kodi: trailers and videos, best movies and series, new entries, search. Unofficial add-on.
extension.news: 0.9.16 - Filter search: genre, rating, age, years, country, platform, keyword (the site filter form) 0.9.15 - A row found by two adapters (mirror sites) shows both names 0.9.14 - Clear cache option (settings button and main menu entry) 0.9.13 - VIDEALETOLTES and FILMINVAZIO.PRO: rotating VOE domains are rewritten to voe.sx, the link of the redirect page is read exactly 0.9.12 - VIDEALETOLTES: hosts read from the real film page, the link matching the row host is preferred over ads 0.9.11 - VIDEALETOLTES: search reads the real DooPlay result markup 0.9.10 - VIDEALETOLTES: JSON search and direct film page fallbacks 0.9.9 - New source adapter: VIDEALETOLTES; identical embeds from two adapters are shown once 0.9.8 - Host rows: quality is coloured (4K, 1080p, 720p, HD, SD, DVD, CAM) 0.9.7 - A 403 to the availability probe no longer blocks playback 0.9.6 - HD badge of MoziPont and MoziBox shown as quality 0.9.5 - Older Python fix; refused streams fall back to the next resolver 0.9.4 - ResolveURL link test skip fixed 0.9.3 - Slow CDNs are no longer rejected 0.9.2 - New source adapter: MOZIPONT; faster on Android 0.9.1 - New source adapter: MOZIBOX 0.9.0 - Parallel adapters, perf timing in the log 0.8.0 - People menu 0.1.0 - First release
